basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: Short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | sr. project scientist: Postgraduate (M.Tech./MBA/MCA/MS(R)) in management/social sciences/data systems/behavioural sciences/related discipline and a bachelor's degree in computer science/information technology/cybersecurity/information security/cyber Risk Management/Digital Forensics or a closely related discipline at least 60% marks or CGPA above 6 in both graduation and PG. Minimum of three years of relevant experience in research, specifically in carrying out mixed-methods research and performing both qualitative and quantitative data analysis. Must have knowledge in cybersecurity and cyber risk management domains.

salary_details.details: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill out the form completely with educational qualifications, percentage of marks, division details, and work experience.
Send the duly filled form by email to [email protected].
Mention the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/273/2026) on the subject line of the email.
Ensure the completed application reaches by email before 22/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.
important_instructions: Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview details. Must be willing to travel across India for data collection and volunteer training. Proficient in qualitative data analysis tools and statistical analysis tools with good communication skills. Experience in conducting grounded theory methodology and thematic analysis, conducting data collection through interviews, FGDs, Delphi technique, surveys, developing and validating research instruments, conducting experimental, quasi-experimental research studies and pre-post longitudinal evaluation, auditing data collection, and research writing. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.
